中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Mnemon is a long-term memory agent for LLM assistants. It keeps conversations as raw, dated records "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"and does its
work when a question arrives, dividing that work the way dual-process accounts divide t"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"hinking. A fast decision
model (**System 1**) makes many small yes/no judgments about the records th"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"e searches return. An LLM (**System 2**)
writes a few search queries, names what the reply needs and"},{"id":"p5s5","text":" composes the answer. A background pass consolidates each
record once into an index that points back"},{"id":"p5s6","text":" to the records, so that questions about a whole conversation reach
evidence their own searches miss"},{"id":"p5s7","text":".
The results of this research will be brought step by step into the official projects mnemon and

up and to the left is better."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Most accurate on LoCoMo, from under 4k tokens of context.** Compared with the 14 systems OmniMem"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"Eval
re-evaluated, all with gpt-4.1-mini answering, Mnemon scores **91.7%** on LoCoMo (first of 15 s"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ystems) and
**83.8%** on LongMemEval-S (second of 13). It sends the answering model about **3.8k tok"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ens** per question. It is
the only system above 80% on both benchmarks below 4k tokens.
- **Lowest e"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ffective cost index on LoCoMo:** 0.259, against 0.337 for the next system.
- **On par with the best "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"published results on LongMemEval-S.** With DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash as System 2, Mnemon
reaches **94.4%**"},{"id":"p8s7","text":" on LongMemEval-S and **92.2%** on LoCoMo (95.3% on revised labels).
- **Bounded cost at 10M tokens."},{"id":"p8s8","text":"** From BEAM-100K to BEAM-10M, with 80 times as many records, the cost per question
grows by a facto"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"r of **1.11**, and the work on a question's critical path stays about the same.
- **System 1 judges "},{"id":"p8s10","text":"better.** On the same 14,359 records, Jev separates gold evidence with an AUC of **0.942**.
DeepSeek"},{"id":"p8s11","text":" reaches 0.900 and gpt-4.1-mini 0.853, at 3–11 times Jev's latency.
- **Raw records beat a write-tim"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"e graph built by the same model.** Under one protocol, Jev-Mem, which uses Jev to

95% CI 5.5–9.2)."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Approach"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Fast judgments, slow thoughts"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Most of the read-time work of memory is System 1 work: small, independent yes/no judgments with expl"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"icit criteria.
- Should the reply use this record?
- Is it no longer current?
- Does it give the sec"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ond of the two dates the question needs?"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"A decision model such as Jev makes dozens of these
judgments in a third of a second."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Only a little is System 2 work: writing a few search queries, naming what the reply needs and compos"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ing the answer.
An LLM does this well but slowly."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Because the judging is fast, Mnemon can afford to read raw records when a question arrives instead o"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"f rewriting them
in advance. The rules between the two systems read only what System 1 reliably give"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"s: its ranking and its yes/no
decision. They call on System 2 only when no judged record satisfies a"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" ranking and its yes/no
decision. They call on System 2 only when no judged record satisfies a need."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Mnemon at one user turn. It runs as a second instance of DeepSeek Harness
beside the main agent, whi"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ch it leaves unchanged, and publishes one View per turn."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Memory without a write-time schema"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Systems that extract at write time must decide in advance what counts as a fact, an entity or a pref"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"erence. Each new
kind of data then needs a new extraction schema. Mnemon decides nothing about a rec"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ord when it is written, so it needs
from a store only a search route that returns dated records."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The consolidated index (topic timelines, value histories, standing instructions) sits on top of the "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"records and
points back to them. It is an overlay on the records, not their schema. Mnemon reads the"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" records with or without it."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Keeping records raw also lets the memory grow without rewriting what is stored. A record can be sear"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ched as soon as it
is embedded; organizing runs in the background and can be redone from the records"},{"id":"p19s3","text":". Longer histories, stronger
answering models and new rules apply to everything already stored."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Memory of this kind can be added wherever records can be searched. The paper evaluates conversationa"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"l memory, the
